text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(So this is a Triple Tiara race...
A stage where everyone gets only one shot.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...Sure, it did feel a little special.
But—)
(WAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that was a great race!!
The battle for the Triple Tiara has officially kicked off this year too!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I hope we get to see plenty of
graceful, dazzling races this year too~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That said, the Spring Classics are just getting started!
Next week is finally the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: The race that determines the fastest Umamusume...! We absolutely cannot miss this~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh, like... I... said...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy does the 'fastest Umamusume'
have to be decided only at the Satsuki Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh, geez!!
Something feels offーー!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! My racing magic is
still totally incomplete...!

And so, a few days later. An interview about future plans
was held with the Umamusume on the Triple Tiara path,
including Sweep Tosho, but—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, next up I'll naturally be aiming to
enter the 'Oaks'. So please continue
to cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Next up, Sweep Tosho-san and
her Trainer. We would love to
hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "Could you tell us about your future outlook and goals?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. It's not some petty thing like "prospects" or "goals," you know—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
One day, I will definitely
cast a spell on every single one of you!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then, I'm gonna change all those boring common sense rules and ways of thinking, every single one of 'em!
(Murmur...)
A faint ripple of unease spread around us. Piercing gazes pierced right through me, seemingly asking, "Shouldn't someone stop them?"
choice_data_list: (...No, I'm not going to stop them)

text_block_list.text:
Because this is the absolute truth—
Sweep Tosho's one and only, absolute dream and goal.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I see, magic... is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of things do you mean by
"boring common sense and ways of thinking,"
Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: People saying that "girls from the Triple Crown route are stronger than girls from the Triple Tiara route" and all that garbage!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No matter where they come from, the strongest runner is the strongest!
If a Tiara girl beats a Triple Crown girl, it's a miracle? The Satsuki Sho is inherently faster than the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's sooooo utterly boring!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, I understand
very well what you mean."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Still... fully aware of how rude it may be,
please allow me to ask one more question."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To speak candidly, as a matter of fact, races such as the Arima Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen
often produce results that prove this.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: When Umamusume from the Triple Crown road and those from the Triple Tiara road clash in the Senior Year, the latter tends to be overpowered—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You could say history proves it.
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then I'll just change history itself along with it!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove it to everyone, myself!!
Triple Tiara route or not,
a strong Umamusume is just plain strong!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll sprint through the Triple Tiara!
And then, once I reach the Senior Class—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat those girls from the Triple Crown road fair and square, and show 'em just how strong I really am!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now listen here, reporter? When the time comes,
if you write boring nonsense about "oh, girls on the Triple Tiara route this or that,"
I will punish you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All that matters is everyone saying,
'Sweep Tosho was the absolute strongest!'
That's all I need!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's the 'magic' you want to show, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter which path they came from.
I will prove through results in the Senior Class
that a truly strong Umamusume simply is strong—!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We look forward to your future successes.
Thank you very much!!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

While Reporter Otonashi seemed to understand to some extent,
the venue remained enveloped in a murmur of confusion.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, silly familiar.
I only did what was obvious!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Familiar...! 
Ah, what a wonderful relationship!
You're devoted to her to that extent!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And from here on, through fire, water, taboos,
and even cursed lands, you are prepared to race through
it all at Miss Sweep's command...!
choice_data_list: (Not to that extent... wait, or would it...?)

text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi often tends to exaggerate our struggles,
but this time it feels like no exaggeration at all, as I reflect on a future already filled with hardship—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, familiar!
Don't slack off, on to the next, the next!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll run a special race and perfect my magic!
So make sure you train me properly all the way to the Oaks!

The next goal is the Yushun Himba (Oaks), the second leg
of the Triple Tiara. A fierce battle to crown the Queen of Oaks
awaits the little witch...!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What's that about "magic"? Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now you're talking about the Senior Class...?
Do you already consider yourself the representative of our generation?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ――...What's that supposed to mean...?! Even I can...!!
